title: A left fold in f32
hints: Two things are off: the fold starts from `0.0` instead of the first element, and nothing rounds to f32.
Pattern match `x :: rest`, then `List.fold_left (fun acc y -> f32 (acc +. y)) x rest`.
Starting from `0.0` breaks `[-0.0]` (since `0.0 +. -0.0` is `0.0`), and skipping the rounding breaks `[16777216.0; 1.0; 1.0]` (in f32 each `+ 1` rounds away).
explain: Rounding after every add is what f32 hardware does, and starting from the first element (not from `0.0`) keeps `-0.0` and matches the spec's fold exactly. `3e38 + 3e38` overflows to `inf` in f32 even though it fits in a double, so the next `- 3e38` can't bring it back.
